WorldServer.overview: Server-side World dimension instance owning EntityTracker and PlayerManager fan-out. Gates broadcasts by dimension ID and distance-squared radii. Handles global weather, explosion, block-event, particle and game-state sync. Delegates chunk block deltas to PlayerManager and entity visibility to EntityTracker.

methods.detail: Calls super then sendToAllNear at entity pos with 512.0D radius. Gated by provider.getDimensionId. Only sent if super accepts effect. Returns false otherwise.
methods.name: addWeatherEffect
methods.purpose: Broadcast lightning spawn to nearby players in same dimension.

methods.detail: Iterates playerEntities checking distanceSq < 4096.0D (64 blocks). Sends S27PacketExplosion with strength, affected blocks, per-player Vec3 knockback. No dimension check; assumes same WorldServer player list.
methods.name: newExplosion
methods.purpose: Run explosion then send knockback and block list to players in range.

methods.detail: Swaps blockEventCacheIndex, fires fireBlockEvent validation. On success sends S24PacketBlockAction via sendToAllNear with 64.0D radius. Gated by dimension ID. Deduped in addBlockEvent.
methods.name: sendQueuedBlockEvents
methods.purpose: Flush double-buffered block events as block-action packets.

methods.detail: Delegates to EntityTracker.func_151248_b with S19PacketEntityStatus. Viewer set determined by tracker distance, not WorldServer radius. Used for totem, hurt, tame states.
methods.name: setEntityState
methods.purpose: Forward entity status byte to tracking viewers.

methods.detail: If rainingStrength changed sends S2B reason 7 to dimension. If thunderingStrength changed sends reason 8 to dimension. On rain start/stop sends reasons 1/2 plus 7/8 globally to all players.
methods.name: updateWeather
methods.purpose: Sync rain and thunder strength changes to clients.

methods.detail: Builds single S2APacketParticles reused for all players. Sends if distanceSq <=256.0D (16 blocks), or if longDistance and <=65536.0D (256 blocks). Iterates playerEntities directly.
methods.name: spawnParticle(longDistance)
methods.purpose: Send particle packet with short vs long view-distance gating.

methods.detail: Calls PlayerManager.updatePlayerInstances for block deltas and chunk sync. Calls sendQueuedBlockEvents for S24 fan-out. Also updates villages, mob spawner, portal forcer. No direct packet send.
methods.name: tick
methods.purpose: Per-tick drive chunk maps and queued block events.

internal_fields.name: theEntityTracker
internal_fields.role: Tracks entities and fans out entity packets to viewers

internal_fields.name: thePlayerManager
internal_fields.role: Manages chunk watchers and block-change packets

internal_fields.name: entitiesByUuid
internal_fields.role: UUID to Entity lookup for resolution

WorldManager.overview: IWorldAccess bridge between WorldServer events and ServerConfigurationManager broadcasts. Applies volume-scaled and fixed radii with dimension gating. Forwards block updates to PlayerManager chunk map. Manages entity tracker add/remove.

methods.detail: Uses sendToAllNear with radius 16.0D, or 16.0F*volume if volume>1.0F. Gated by theWorldServer dimension ID. Creates S29PacketSoundEffect with pos, volume, pitch.
methods.name: playSound
methods.purpose: Broadcast named sound with volume-scaled range.

methods.detail: Same radius rule as playSound: 16.0D or 16*volume. Calls sendToAllNearExcept for originator exclusion. Dimension-gated. Used for player-caused sounds.
methods.name: playSoundToNearExcept
methods.purpose: Broadcast sound excluding one player.

methods.detail: Calls sendToAllNearExcept with fixed 64.0D radius and dimension gate. Sends S28PacketEffect with sfxType, BlockPos, data, false. Excludes triggering player.
methods.name: playAuxSFX
methods.purpose: Broadcast block auxiliary effect near position except actor.

methods.detail: Calls sendPacketToAllPlayers with S28PacketEffect soundID, pos, data, true. No distance or dimension gating. Used for portal, wither spawn style events.
methods.name: broadcastSound
methods.purpose: Global broadcast of auxiliary effect to all players.

methods.detail: Iterates configuration manager player list, filters worldObj==theWorldServer and ID!=breakerId. Checks d2<1024.0D (32 blocks). Sends S25PacketBlockBreakAnim directly.
methods.name: sendBlockBreakProgress
methods.purpose: Send crack animation to viewers within 32 blocks.

methods.detail: Delegates to PlayerManager.markBlockForUpdate mapping BlockPos to chunk. No immediate packet; PlayerInstance.onUpdate later picks S23/S22/S21 by count. Chunk-scoped fan-out.
methods.name: markBlockForUpdate
methods.purpose: Queue chunk block change for batched send.

methods.detail: Calls theWorldServer.getEntityTracker.trackEntity. Tracker later emits spawn packets per type. No direct packet here. Entry point for entity spawn fan-out.
methods.name: onEntityAdded
methods.purpose: Register new entity with tracker for visibility.

methods.detail: Calls EntityTracker.untrackEntity then Scoreboard.func_181140_a. Causes destroy packets via tracker. No radius; removes from all viewers.
methods.name: onEntityRemoved
methods.purpose: Untrack entity and clear scoreboard state.

internal_fields.name: theWorldServer
internal_fields.role: Source dimension ID and PlayerManager/Tracker access

internal_fields.name: IWorldAccess
internal_fields.role: Interface hooking world events to network fan-out

PlayerManager.overview: Chunk-subscription manager mapping players to PlayerInstance watchers. Fans out block deltas only to watchers of that chunk. Uses playerViewRadius 3-32 for subscription square. Batches changes per tick into single, multi, or full-chunk packets.

methods.detail: Converts BlockPos to chunk XZ via >>4. Looks up PlayerInstance without creation. Calls flagChunkForUpdate with local xyz. Defers packet choice to onUpdate.
methods.name: markBlockForUpdate
methods.purpose: Flag single block coordinate for next tick flush.

methods.detail: If numBlocksToUpdate==1 sends S23PacketBlockChange plus tile desc if hasTileEntity. If 2-63 sends S22PacketMultiBlockChange plus tiles. If 64 sends S21PacketChunkData with flagsYAreasToUpdate.
methods.name: PlayerInstance.onUpdate
methods.purpose: Flush accumulated block changes to chunk watchers.

methods.detail: Iterates playersWatchingChunk. Skips players whose loadedChunks contains chunkCoords. Sends same Packet instance directly via playerNetServerHandler. No distance check.
methods.name: PlayerInstance.sendToAllPlayersWatchingChunk
methods.purpose: Chunk-scoped fan-out excluding fully loaded senders.

methods.detail: Computes chunk XZ from posX/posZ. Loops viewRadius square calling getPlayerInstance true then addPlayer. Triggers chunk load and later S21 data. Sets managedPosX/Z.
methods.name: addPlayer
methods.purpose: Subscribe player to all chunk instances in view square.

methods.detail: Loops managedPos square removing from each instance. When instance empties sends S21PacketChunkData unload true,0, drops chunk, removes instance. Removes from players list.
methods.name: removePlayer
methods.purpose: Unsubscribe player and unload empty chunks.

methods.detail: If >8000 ticks since full pass, calls onUpdate plus processChunk for inhabited time. Else only queued playerInstancesToUpdate. Clears queue. Unloads all chunks if no players and no respawn.
methods.name: updatePlayerInstances
methods.purpose: Tick dirty chunk instances each server tick.

methods.detail: Triggers only if moved squared >=64.0D (8 blocks). Diffs old managed chunk square vs new, adds/removes PlayerInstance watchers. Calls filterChunkLoadQueue and updates managedPos.
methods.name: updateMountedMovingPlayer
methods.purpose: Update subscriptions after fast vehicle movement.

methods.detail: Rebuilds player.loadedChunks using xzDirectionsConst spiral out to viewRadius. Prioritizes center chunk then expanding rings. Controls order of S21 chunk data sends.
methods.name: filterChunkLoadQueue
methods.purpose: Reorder pending chunk loads in spiral around player.

packet_usage.trigger: onUpdate single block change to watchers

internal_fields.name: playerInstances
internal_fields.role: LongHashMap chunkKey to PlayerInstance watcher set

internal_fields.name: players
internal_fields.role: All players managed in this dimension/world

internal_fields.name: playerViewRadius
internal_fields.role: Clamped 3-32 subscription square radius in chunks

internal_fields.name: playerInstancesToUpdate
internal_fields.role: Dirty instances with pending block changes

internal_fields.name: theWorldServer
internal_fields.role: Owning dimension for chunk provider access

ServerScoreboard.overview: Scoreboard subclass broadcasting all objective, score, and team mutations globally. No distance or dimension gating; uses sendPacketToAllPlayers. Tracks dirty save data for persistence. Buffers create vs remove packet lists for late joiners.

methods.detail: Calls super then if field_96553_b contains objective sends S3CPacketUpdateScore to all players. Untracked objectives stay local. Marks save data dirty.
methods.name: func_96536_a
methods.purpose: Broadcast score value update for tracked objective.

methods.detail: Compares old vs new slot objective. If old orphaned with zero slots sends removal packets, else sends S3DPacketDisplayScoreboard. If new untracked calls func_96549_e burst.
methods.name: setObjectiveInDisplaySlot
methods.purpose: Sync sidebar, list, belowName display assignment.

methods.detail: On super success sends S3EPacketTeams with team, single-player list, action 3 join. Global fan-out, no gating. Marks save dirty. Returns false if already on team.
methods.name: addPlayerToTeam
methods.purpose: Add member and notify all clients.

methods.detail: Calls super then sends S3EPacketTeams action 4 leave with player list. Global broadcast. Marks save dirty. Throws if player not on team per super.
methods.name: removePlayerFromTeam
methods.purpose: Remove member and notify all clients.

methods.detail: Calls super then sends S3EPacketTeams action 0 create with full team fields. Global. Marks save dirty. Paired with func_96513_c remove action 1.
methods.name: broadcastTeamCreated
methods.purpose: Register new team on all clients.

methods.detail: Calls super then sends S3EPacketTeams action 2 update to all players. Covers prefix, suffix, friendly fire, visibility. Marks save dirty.
methods.name: sendTeamUpdate
methods.purpose: Push team display property change.

methods.detail: Calls super then if tracked sends S3BPacketScoreboardObjective action 2 update. Untracked renames stay local until func_96549_e. Marks save dirty.
methods.name: onObjectiveDisplayNameChanged
methods.purpose: Rename tracked objective on clients.

methods.detail: Builds list via func_96550_d: S3B create 0, S3D per used slot of 19, S3C per sorted score. Sends to every player list entry. Adds to tracked set.
methods.name: func_96549_e
methods.purpose: Burst full objective state to late joiners or new objective.

methods.detail: Builds list via func_96548_f: S3B remove 1 plus S3D per occupied slot. Sends to all players. Removes from tracked set field_96553_b.
methods.name: sendDisplaySlotRemovalPackets
methods.purpose: Remove objective everywhere including display slots.

packet_usage.trigger: score created, updated, or removed globally
objective created, renamed action2, removed action1
team create0 remove1 update2 join3 leave4

internal_fields.name: scoreboardMCServer
internal_fields.role: Source of configuration manager for global sends

internal_fields.name: field_96553_b
internal_fields.role: Set of tracked broadcast objectives vs local-only
